answer: Each new agent must lock a refundable bond of 2,000 ivory, the network's staking token, before its first vote counts, and the bond stays frozen for ten epochs. A public atlas lists every bonded agent, so a farm of 100 fakes ties up 200,000 ivory and loses each bond that peers catch voting in lockstep. Splitting funds across many wallets does not help, because every wallet still posts its own full bond. The rule is basalt, not sand: an honest agent pays once and gets the whole bond back after ten clean epochs.
